Trading at less than 2 times its estimated book value, HDFC's challenges include difficulty in attracting low-cost deposits, past regulatory restrictions on credit cards, and management improprieties. While some Indian banks like ICICI Bank are performing well, HDFC's path to restoring its valuation faces significant obstacles.

events.title: BMO and RBC sell Moneris to Francisco Partners for $1.44bn

events.title: BofA to Plow $250 Billion Into Critical Infrastructure Projects

This move follows similar pledges from other major US banks like Morgan Stanley and JPMorgan Chase, addressing the country's aging infrastructure and the demands of new technologies like AI.

events.title: BofA to plow $250 billion into critical infrastructure projects

events.title: Morgan Stanley Warns Investors Underestimating SpaceX’s AI Unit
events.summary: Morgan Stanley analysts believe investors are significantly undervaluing SpaceX's AI business, including its neocloud partnerships and the impact of its Cursor acquisition. They project Cursor's annual revenue run rate to reach $33 billion by 2030, suggesting that as more details emerge about the Cursor/Grok integration, SpaceX's stock could see substantial appreciation. The analysts argue that the current market valuation for SpaceX's AI segment is "extremely conservative."

Super Micro also forecasted 2027 revenue above Wall Street estimates, highlighting resilient customer investment in AI servers.

events.title: AFC Raises CHF 350 Million in Landmark Swiss Digital Bond Deal
events.summary: The Africa Finance Corporation (AFC) has successfully raised CHF 350 million through a five-year digital bond, marking it as the first African institution to issue a digital bond on a regulated digital exchange and the largest digital bond in the Swiss Franc market. This issuance, supported by strong investment-grade credit ratings, diversifies AFC's funding channels and will be used to finance infrastructure projects across Africa. The bond is structured as a tokenized security using Distributed Ledger Technology, highlighting AFC's adoption of new capital market technologies.

Other financial institutions like the National Bank of Canada have also invested in XRP ETFs, signifying a shift in institutional XRP accumulation with new midsize asset managers replacing earlier major players.

events.title: Wolverine Trims Nio Puts, Adds to 2029 Convertible Notes in Second Quarter
events.summary: Wolverine Asset Management reduced its Nio Inc. put options for the fourth consecutive quarter while increasing its holdings of Nio's 2029 convertible notes. The firm's put options on Nio decreased by 14.5% to 14.18 million underlying shares, while it added to its $72.65 million principal amount of Nio's 3.875% convertible senior notes. This strategy is consistent with convertible arbitrage, where equity exposure from notes is hedged, and follows a period of Nio's share price decline.

events.title: Spectacular new Morgan Stanley display lights up Times Square: ‘Broadway is a bit brighter’
events.summary: Morgan Stanley has unveiled a spectacular new 21,000-square-foot digital display at its 1585 Broadway headquarters in Times Square. The installation, which features 31.5 million pixels and frequently showcases "CRYPTO" messages, replaces an older display from 2015. Times Square Alliance president Tom Harris noted that this "significant investment" has made Broadway "a bit brighter."

events.title: Morgan Stanley’s Weaver Warns of Risks in AI-Compute Bottleneck
events.summary: Morgan Stanley's Michelle Weaver warns that artificial intelligence growth is constrained by a persistent bottleneck in computing supply. She notes that demand for AI computing continues to outstrip available capacity and anticipates that power, political, and labor bottlenecks will limit supply for the next few years, preventing an oversupply situation.

events.title: Morgan Stanley Maintains Brookfield Infrastructure Partners LP(BIP.US) With Buy Rating, Maintains Target Price $48

events.title: Earnings call transcript: Presidio Production posts q2 2026 beat on EBITDA
events.summary: Presidio Production reported a strong Q2 2026, exceeding its adjusted EBITDA guidance with $33.2 million, driven by higher production, better pricing, and lower operating costs, partly due to AI tools. The company generated $0.34 EPS and $54 million in revenue, covering its quarterly dividend with $15.7 million in free cash flow. Despite expected lower EBITDA in Q3 and Q4 due to weaker commodity prices, Presidio is on track for 3%-5% AI-driven production uplift and aims for future dividend increases following the Canyon Creek acquisition.

events.title: Morgan Stanley's infrastructure partner Zerohash rebuffed in pitch to be U.S. trust bank

The company plans to re-file its application with a narrower scope, hoping for a quicker review. This development comes amidst Zerohash's ongoing legal battle with its former chief compliance officer, who alleged numerous compliance gaps, and previous investment and acquisition discussions.

events.title: Piper Sandler Initiates Unusual Machines at Overweight, Sees 46% Upside for Drone Parts Maker
events.summary: Piper Sandler initiated coverage of Unusual Machines (UMAC), a drone parts manufacturer, with an Overweight rating and a $38 price target, implying a 46% upside. Analyst Clarke Jeffries highlighted the company's position as a pure-play drone beneficiary, supplying over half of the Pentagon's Drone Dominance Phase 1 contract winners, amidst regulatory tailwinds favoring domestic drone component production. Despite risks associated with aggressive production scaling, the firm projects significant revenue growth and sees an attractive opportunity in the company's focus on the domestic market.

events.title: How Investors May Respond To Charles Schwab (SCHW) Balancing Linqto Litigation And US$2.6 Billion Note Issuance
events.summary: Charles Schwab (SCHW) is currently navigating a lawsuit from Linqto over an alleged broken trustee commitment, alongside completing a US$2.6 billion note issuance. While the litigation introduces headline and legal risk, the note offering addresses Schwab’s funding profile and balance sheet flexibility, which are crucial for supporting its diversified broker, wealth, and banking model. Investors should monitor both the ongoing legal dispute and how Schwab manages its funding to assess the company's investment narrative and future growth prospects.

events.title: Moodys Stock And 2 Bond Market Plays If CPI Shifts Rate Cut Expectations
events.summary: This article discusses three companies—BGC Group, Moody's, and Artisan Partners Asset Management—that are particularly exposed to shifts in interest rate expectations, especially following the upcoming July CPI report. These companies offer various ways for investors to gain exposure to the bond market, from brokerage services to risk assessment and investment management. The piece highlights their financial profiles and potential implications of changing inflation and interest rate environments.

events.title: 5 Insightful Analyst Questions From Pfizer’s Q2 Earnings Call
events.summary: Pfizer's Q2 2026 earnings showed stability in its core business, driven by strong non-COVID portfolio performance and recent acquisitions. Revenue beat analyst estimates at $15.03 billion, and adjusted EPS also surpassed expectations at $0.77. The article highlights key analyst questions from the earnings call, covering topics like prostate cancer trial benchmarks, non-COVID revenue growth drivers, mevrometostat's commercial potential, atirmociclib's efficacy, and dividend sustainability.

events.title: Firefly CEO Jason Kim Sees ‘So Much Demand’ For Rocket Launches As Capacity Hits Record Constraints
events.summary: Firefly Aerospace CEO Jason Kim states that demand for rocket launches is at an unprecedented high, with existing and new customers showing strong interest. The company recently extended its agreement with Lockheed Martin for up to 25 launches through 2031 and is ramping up production at a record pace. Despite a lowered price target by Roth Capital, analysts maintain a 'Buy' rating due to the robust demand environment, and retail sentiment is extremely bullish following strong Q2 earnings.

events.title: Morgan Stanley's Adam Jonas lays out how SpaceX can unlock a long-term bullish stock move
events.summary: Morgan Stanley analyst Adam Jonas believes SpaceX can achieve a long-term bullish stock move, driven by the potential of its SpaceXAI division, particularly with products like Grok Bot. Jonas emphasizes that for SpaceXAI to be valued beyond a "neocloud," it needs to demonstrate its ability to deliver competitive, value-added products that leverage its unique advantages in intelligence, real-time data, and connectivity. Despite recent volatility and higher-than-expected capital expenditures, analysts suggest betting against Elon Musk has historically been a "fool's errand," implying long-term optimism for SpaceX, albeit with anticipated short-term fluctuations.

events.title: ArcelorMittal remains Morgan Stanley’s preferred way to invest in European reindustrialisation

events.title: How Is Morgan Stanley Strengthening Its Position in Digital Assets?
events.summary: Morgan Stanley is significantly expanding its digital-asset strategy by launching the Morgan Stanley Ethereum Trust and Morgan Stanley Solana Trust, complementing its existing Bitcoin Trust. These new exchange-traded products (ETPs) offer regulated exposure to ether and SOL, with a competitive 0.14% expense ratio and staking features, positioning Morgan Stanley to compete with other major asset managers like BlackRock and Invesco. This move aligns with Morgan Stanley's broader efforts to bolster its wealth and asset management businesses and integrate digital assets into diversified investment portfolios.

events.title: Eli Lilly Shares Approach Record High While Retatrutide Legal Action Secures New Obesity Hope
events.summary: Eli Lilly's shares are near a record high as the company files six lawsuits against alleged illegal sales of its experimental obesity drug, retatrutide. These legal actions aim to protect the drug's future market ahead of its planned U.S. submission in Q1 2027, given its strong Phase 3 efficacy data. The lawsuits are a proactive measure to safeguard its next major franchise, as current revenue drivers Mounjaro and Zepbound already contribute significantly to Lilly's earnings.

events.title: Morgan Stanley Enters Bitcoin ETF Race With The Lowest Fee On Market

The global AI infrastructure spending cycle appears robust, benefiting companies like HPE, Dell, and HP Inc.

(NASDAQ: BRCB), urging shareholders who acquired stock in the September 2025 IPO or between September 12, 2025, and May 12, 2026, to review their options.
